specification.population: original training partition only; development evidence
specification.selection: per-outer-fold, three inner cluster folds; first in frozen parsimony order within one fold-SE of best mean inner panel median
specification.family_selector: same parsimony rule on selected candidate's inner scores; original-only is first and always available
specification.centering: gradient-fitting rows only; shrink toward shared fitting mean; unseen alleles use that shared mean
specification.early_stopping: further cluster folds wholly within each candidate fitting partition; MLP MSE, trees RMSE/PairLogit; predictions never on stopping rows
specification.ranker_scale: positive affine slope>=1e-8 fit to clean nested-selected crossfit scores inside outer fitting partition; raw fold scores reported separately
specification.ranker_pair_recipe: all untied within-allele pairs, equal total weight per contributing allele, weights rescaled to mean 1
specification.mapping_training_size_difference: crossfit base models fit 2/3 of outer-fitting rows before their stopping splits, whereas outer base models use the complete outer fitting partition before stopping; same 6-member recipe
specification.inner_final_recipe_difference: inner MLP screening uses 3 stopping folds x 2 encodings x seeds0,1=12; final original and centred MLP use original 5 x2 x seeds0,1,2=30; trees always 3 x1 x seeds0,1=6

fit_graph.repeats_additional_fits: 150 reference plus 150 MLP or 30 tree finalist refits; ranker mapping may be reused only for the identical locked refit-repeat endpoint

specification.primary_statistic: pooled outer-held median per-allele Spearman; fixed evaluation tie/constant rules
specification.comparisons: every component and inner-selected sequence vs original; no Boltz comparison until extraction passes
specification.repeats: two additional identical-seed refits of original, A1 and A4 after initial fit; report paired seed0/1 diagnostics separately
specification.runtime_ceiling: local only; no automatic cloud launch or grid expansion
